title: AWL 学术词汇
subtitle: 源自 Academic Word List（Averil Coxhead），北美大学英语教学广泛使用的 570 学术词族

defsEn: v consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
v break down into components or essential features
v make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of
break down into components or essential features
v subject to psychoanalytic treatment
zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解
examples: Descriptions can be analysed in terms of their focus and point of view.
You cannot analyse the data efficiently unless you draw a plot.

defsEn: n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something
n. the event of one object coming closer to another
n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
zh: n. 接近, 入门
vt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量
vi. 靠近
examples: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
We should approach this problem from different angles.
exampleZh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。
我们应该用各种不同的角度看待此问题

defsEn: n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
n. a subject of study
n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
n. a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function
zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地
examples: Please find the area of the triangle.
I know this area pretty well.
exampleZh: 求三角形的面积
我很了解这地方。

defsEn: v. charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine
v. estimate the value of (property) for taxation
zh: vt. 估定, 对...征税, 评定
examples: She can assess investments very accurately.
You must assess the situation and act accordingly.
exampleZh: 她能很准确地评估投资。

defsEn: v. take to be the case or to be true
accept without verification or proof
v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
v. take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect
v. occupy or take on
zh: vt. 假定, 承担, 呈现
vi. 装腔作势, 僭越
examples: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
exampleZh: 我想你不会那么做的吧。
她以为所有人都会赞成计划。

defsEn: n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions
n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
n. an expert whose views are taken as definitive
n. official permission or approval
zh: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家
examples: He is a great authority on economics.
He gave me authority to fire them.
exampleZh: 他是权威的经济学家。
他授权给我解雇了他们。

defsEn: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
s. not busy
not otherwise committed
s. convenient for use or disposal
zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的
examples: This book is available at one shop only.
There is a position available for a secretary.
exampleZh: 只有一家商店卖这本书。
有一个做秘书的空缺职位。

defsEn: n. financial assistance in time of need
n. something that aids or promotes well-being
n. a performance to raise money for a charitable cause
v. be beneficial for
zh: n. 利益
vt. 有益于
vi. 受益
examples: There are lots of benefits from travelling abroad.
He might benefit from a conversation with you.
exampleZh: 去国外旅行有很多好处。

defsEn: n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
zh: n. 观念, 概念
examples: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
I really like the concept of this website.
exampleZh: 对他来说，「肚子饿」是个抽象的概念，因为他从来就没有饿过。
我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。

defsEn: v. have its essential character
be comprised or contained in
be embodied in
v. be consistent in form, tenor, or character
be congruous
v. be composed of
zh: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
examples: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
Man consists of soul and body.
exampleZh: 我们呼吸的空气是由氧气和氮气组成的。
人是由灵魂和肉身组成的。

defsEn: v. form or compose
zh: vt. 构成, 组成, 任命
examples: These things constitute a balanced meal.
A committee was constituted to investigate prices.
exampleZh: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。
为了调查物价，成立了一个委员会。

defsEn: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
zh: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉
n. 上下文
examples: If I know the context, I understand the text.
Whatever the context, we will obtain our freedom!

defsEn: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
n. (contract bridge) the highest bid becomes the contract setting the number of tricks that the bidder must make
n. a variety of bridge in which the bidder receives points toward game only for the number of tricks he bid
v. enter into a contractual arrangement
zh: n. 合约, 婚约, 契约
vt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结
vi. 皱缩, 订约, 收缩
examples: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.
exampleZh: 你在签字前必须仔细看合同。
他们的合同在这个月底到期。

defsEn: v. bring into existence
v. pursue a creative activity
be engaged in a creative activity
v. invest with a new title, office, or rank
v. create by artistic means
zh: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
examples: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
You need to create two new categories.
exampleZh: 起初，神创造了天地。
需新建两个分类。

defsEn: n. a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn
zh: pl. 资料, 数据
examples: This is a very good data base.
My data-burning software is showing an error message.
exampleZh: 这是个非常好的数据库。
我的刻录软件显示了一个错误信息。

defsEn: v. give a definition for the meaning of a word
v. determine the nature of
v. show the form or outline of
zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
examples: In a word, how would you define technology?
How would you define a successful marriage?

defsEn: v. obtain
v. come from
v. develop or evolve from a latent or potential state
be connected by a relationship of blood, for example
zh: vt. 得自
vi. 起源
examples: This word is derived from Greek.
The lonely man derives pleasure from observing ants.
exampleZh: 这个词来源于希腊语。
那个孤僻的人以观察蚂蚁取乐。

defsEn: v. administer or bestow, as in small portions
v. make available
v. give to several people
v. spread throughout a given area
zh: vt. 分配, 散布, 分发
examples: How can we generate and distribute even more resources?
We would like to distribute this product in Japan.

defsEn: n. the system of production and distribution and consumption
n. the efficient use of resources
n. frugality in the expenditure of money or resources
n. an act of economizing
reduction in cost
zh: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
examples: I hope the economy picks up soon.
What do you think of Japan's economy?
exampleZh: 我希望经济很快复苏起来。
您怎样看日本的经济呢？

defsEn: n. the totality of surrounding conditions
n. the area in which something exists or lives
zh: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕
examples: They have no impact on the environment.
They live in a good environment.
exampleZh: 它们对环境一点都没有影响。
他们的生活环境很好。

defsEn: v. set up or found
v. set up or lay the groundwork for
v. bring about
v. use as a basis for
found on
zh: vt. 建立, 确立, 制定
vi. 移植生长
examples: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
People established churches and schools there.
exampleZh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。
人们在那里建立了教堂和学校。

defsEn: n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth
n. a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody
n. a statement indicating the likely cost of some job
n. the respect with which a person is held
zh: n. 估计, 判断
vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
vi. 估计
examples: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
exampleZh: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。
算一算你花了多少钱买书。

defsEn: s clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
s capable of being seen or noticed
zh: a. 显然的, 明显的
examples: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
It is evident that he has made a mistake.
exampleZh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
很明显的是他犯了错。

defsEn: n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country
v. sell or transfer abroad
v. transfer (electronic data) out of a database or document in a format that can be used by other programs
v. cause to spread in another part of the world
zh: n. 输出品, 输出
vt. 输出, 出口
vi. 输出物资
examples: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
Can they export more goods this year?
exampleZh: 台币上涨，造成台湾的出口贸易不振。

defsEn: n. anything that contributes causally to a result
n. any of the numbers (or symbols) that form a product when multiplied together
n. an independent variable in statistics
v. resolve into factors
zh: n. 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人
examples: Several factors operated to help prices go up.
Wealth may be a factor of happiness.
exampleZh: 物价上涨是多方因素造成的。

defsEn: n. the commercial activity of providing funds and capital
n. the branch of economics that studies the management of money and other assets
n. the management of money and credit and banking and investments
v. obtain or provide money for
zh: n. 财政, 财务
vt. 供给...经费, 负担经费
vi. 筹措资金
examples: He claimed to be an expert in finance.
The new finance manager should have started by now.
exampleZh: 他自称为金融专家。

defsEn: n. a group of symbols that make a mathematical statement
n. a conventionalized statement expressing some fundamental principle
n. a representation of a substance using symbols for its constituent elements
n. a liquid food for infants
zh: n. 客套语, 公式, 准则
examples: The chemical formula for water is H-O-H.
A formula is very convenient, because you need not think about it.
exampleZh: 水的化学式为H-O-H。

defsEn: n. (mathematics) a mathematical relation such that each element of a given set (the domain of the function) is associated with an element of another set (the range of the function)
n. what something is used for
n. the actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
n. a relation such that one thing is dependent on another
zh: n. 官能, 职务, 功能, 函数
vi. 活动, 运行, 行使职责
examples: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
A quadratic function cannot be used here.
exampleZh: 每一个函数都应该有描述其目的的注释以避免误解。
二次函数在这里是不可用的。

defsEn: v. recognize as being
establish the identity of someone or something
v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else
v. conceive of as united or associated
v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与
vi. 一致, 认同
examples: She identified him as the murderer.
You can identify children's voices without any problem.
exampleZh: 她确认他是杀人凶手。
你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。

defsEn: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
zh: n. 收入, 收益, 流入
examples: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
My income is a far cry from his.
exampleZh: 他的大部分收入付了租金。
我的工资比他少多了。

defsEn: v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing
either spatially or figuratively
v. to state or express briefly
v. suggest the necessity of an intervention
in medicine
zh: vt. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出
examples: The arrow indicates the way to go.
Smiles do not always indicate pleasure.
exampleZh: 箭头表示行进方向。
微笑并不一定表示高兴。

defsEn: n. a single organism
a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person
s. separate and distinct from others of the same kind
s. characteristic of or meant for a single person or thing
zh: n. 人, 个人, 个体
a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
examples: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
She had an individual style of speaking.
exampleZh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
她说话有自己的风格。

defsEn: v. make sense of
assign a meaning to
v. give an interpretation or rendition of
zh: vt. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解
vi. 翻译, 解释
examples: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
How do you interpret these words?
exampleZh: 我认为她的沉默就是表示拒绝。
这几个字该怎么解释？

defsEn: v. connect closely and often incriminatingly
v. engage as a participant
v. contain as a part
v. occupy or engage the interest of
zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
examples: Not only you but also I was involved.
We got involved in a traffic accident.
exampleZh: 不止你， 连我也被牵连了。
我们被卷入了一场交通事故。

defsEn: n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
n. one of a series published periodically
n. the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)
n. supplies (as food or clothing or ammunition) issued by the government
zh: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端
vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下
vt. 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
examples: I agree with you on this issue.
This issue has nothing to do with you.
exampleZh: 我同意你对这问题的看法。
这件事与你无关。

defsEn: n a social class comprising those who do manual labor or work for wages
n concluding state of pregnancy
from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
n a political party formed in Great Britain in 1900
characterized by the promotion of labor's interests and formerly the socialization of key industries
n productive work (especially physical work done for wages)
v work hard
v strive and make an effort to reach a goal
v undergo the efforts of childbirth
zh: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩
vi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干
vt. 详细分析, 使厌烦
examples: After manual labour, you may all go home.
He represented the labour union on the committee.

defsEn: a. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules
a. of or relating to jurisprudence
s. having legal efficacy or force
a. relating to or characteristic of the profession of law
zh: a. 法律的, 法定的, 合法的
examples: Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
The legal system in America is the world's finest.
exampleZh: 法律架构的存在，使战争罪犯的责任可以追究。
美国的司法制度是世界上最好的。

defsEn: v. make laws, bills, etc. or bring into effect by legislation
zh: vi. 制定法律
vt. 用立法规定
examples: It's not possible to legislate against stupidity.

defsEn: n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines
below lieutenant colonel and above captain
n. British statesman who was prime minister from 1990 until 1997 (born in 1943)
n. a university student who is studying a particular field as the principal subject
n. the principal field of study of a student at a university
zh: n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
vi. 主修
examples: What do you plan to major in at college?
He majored in literature at the university.
exampleZh: 你计划去大学后主修什么？
他在大学主修文学。

defsEn: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way
implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
zh: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序
examples: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
I apologize for the methods used to get you here.
exampleZh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。
我很抱歉用这种方式把你请来。

defsEn: v. come to one's mind
suggest itself
v. to be found to exist
zh: vi. 发生, 被想到, 存在
examples: It may occur at any moment.
It occurred to me that he might be in the library.
exampleZh: 它随时有可能发生。
我突然想到，他可能在图书馆 。

defsEn: n a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
zh: n. 百分比, 百分数, 部分
examples: We have a five percent chance of success.
I'm not one hundred percent convinced of that.
exampleZh: 我们有百分之五的成功几率。
我不是百分之百确定。

defsEn: n. the interval taken to complete one cycle of a regularly repeating phenomenon
n. (ice hockey) one of three divisions into which play is divided in hockey games
n. a unit of geological time during which a system of rocks formed
n. the end or completion of something
zh: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期
a. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的
interj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
examples: We live in a wonderful period.
The students' lunch period is from twelve to one.
exampleZh: 我们生活在一个精彩的时代。
学生的午饭时间是十二点到一点。

defsEn: n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government
n. written contract or certificate of insurance
zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单
examples: The employment policy is a failure.
The aim of this policy is to improve the environment in the poorest cities.
exampleZh: 工作政策是个失败。
这个政策的目的是改善最贫困城市的环境。

defsEn: n. a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct
n. a rule or standard especially of good behavior
n. a basic truth or law or assumption
n. a rule or law concerning a natural phenomenon or the function of a complex system
zh: n. 原则, 原理, 主义
examples: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
I think these are principles worth dying for.
exampleZh: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。
我认为这些是值得为之献身的原则。

defsEn: v. move ahead
travel onward in time or space
v. follow a certain course
zh: vi. 继续进行, 进行, 开始, 发出, 起诉
examples: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
A large army is proudly proceeding.
exampleZh: 让我们继续进行议程上的项目。
一支大军正浩浩荡荡地行进着。

zh: （技术）处理
examples: Once this process is started, we can get the result within one hour.
This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
exampleZh: 这个进程一旦开始，我们能在一小时内得到结果。
这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。

defsEn: v require as useful, just, or proper
v consider obligatory
request and expect
v make someone do something
v have need of
zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
examples: I would like to but I have a required course tonight.
An aging population will require more spending on health care.
exampleZh: 我不是不想听，但是今晚我有必修课。
老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

defsEn: n. systematic investigation to establish facts
v. attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner
v. inquire into
zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查
examples: He researched British tea culture in great detail.
Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
exampleZh: 他对英国茶文化很有研究。
有关癌症成因的研究耗费颇巨。

defsEn: v. respond favorably or as hoped
zh: vt. 以...回答
vi. 回答, 响应, 回报, 有反应, 承担责任
examples: The president refused to respond to that question.
The secretary responded back to me coldly.
exampleZh: 总统拒绝回答那个问题。
秘书冷漠地回答了我。

defsEn: n. normal or customary activity of a person in a particular social setting
zh: n. 角色, 职责, 任务
examples: Google has played an important role in making information more accessible over the internet.
Do you like role play when you have sex?
exampleZh: Google 在推动网际网路资讯普及化上，发挥了重要作用。

defsEn: n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)
n. a very thin slice (of tissue or mineral or other substance) for examination under a microscope
n. a distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people
n. one of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object
zh: n. 区段, 部分, 区域, 节, 截面, 处, 科, 区, 扇区
vt. 把...分段, 把...切片
vi. 被切成片
examples: Who's in charge of the sales section?
Who's in charge of this section?
exampleZh: 谁负责销售部门？
谁负责这个部门？

defsEn: n. a plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle
n. a social group that forms part of the society or the economy
n. a particular aspect of life or activity
n. the minimum track length that can be assigned to store information
unless otherwise specified a sector of data consists of 512 bytes
zh: n. 扇形, 部门, 部分, 函数尺, 象限仪, 段, 区段
vt. 把...分成扇形
examples: The private sector will make an in-kind contribution.
In the primary sector, you can be auto-sufficient.

defsEn: a. important in effect or meaning
s. fairly large
a. too closely correlated to be attributed to chance and therefore indicating a systematic relation
zh: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含义的, 暗示的, 值得注意的
examples: I think of love as a significant asset.
I desire to make a significant change in my life.

defsEn: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance
s. (of words) expressing closely related meanings
zh: a. 相似的, 类似的
n. 相似的东西
examples: Gold is similar in color to brass.
Your chair is similar to mine.
exampleZh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。
你的椅子和我的很像。

defsEn: n. a document (or organization) from which information is obtained
n. anything that provides inspiration for later work
n. a facility where something is available
n. (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system
zh: n. 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源
examples: Do you have the source code?
His work is a source of pride for him.
exampleZh: 源代码有没有？
他以他的工作为傲。

defsEn: n. a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease
a. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
s. stated explicitly or in detail
a. relating to or distinguishing or constituting a taxonomic species
zh: n. 特效药, 特性
a. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
examples: Could you tell me what your specific requirements are?
You have to be more specific than that.
exampleZh: 可以说说您的具体要求吗？

defsEn: n. a thing constructed
a complex entity constructed of many parts
n. the manner of construction of something and the arrangement of its parts
n. the complex composition of knowledge as elements and their combinations
n. a particular complex anatomical part of a living thing
zh: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物
vt. 构成, 组织
examples: The structure of the brain is complicated.
This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

defsEn: n something that results
n a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
zh: n. 结果, 出口
examples: No one could predict the outcome of this cooperation.
Whatever you do, the outcome will be the same.
exampleZh: 没人能够预言这次合作的结果。

defsEn: n. a person who is a member of a partnership
v. provide with a partner
v. act as a partner
zh: n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣
vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对
vi. 做伙伴, 当助手
examples: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
The two men were business partners.
exampleZh: 老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。
这两个男人是生意上的合作伙伴。

defsEn: n. the rational investigation of questions about existence and knowledge and ethics
n. any personal belief about how to live or how to deal with a situation
zh: n. 哲学, 人生观, 哲学思想, 哲理, 基本原理, 见解, 达观, 沉着
examples: I majored in philosophy at my university.
Philosophy is the love of wisdom.
exampleZh: 我在大学主修哲学。
哲学就是爱智慧。

defsEn: a. involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit
a. relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy
especially physics
s. having substance or material existence
perceptible to the senses
s. according with material things or natural laws (other than those peculiar to living matter)
zh: a. 身体的, 物质的, 自然的, 物理学的, 好色的
n. 体格检查
examples: I'm not fit for physical labor.
On Saturday you do physical education.
exampleZh: 我不能做体力劳动。
星期六你们上体育课。

defsEn: n. the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
n. magnitude or extent
n. the relation between things (or parts of things) with respect to their comparative quantity, magnitude, or degree
n. harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design)
zh: n. 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面积
vt. 使成比例, 使均衡
examples: Men's wants become greater in proportion to the increase in their income.
The punishment should be in proportion to the crime.
exampleZh: 人收入愈高，欲望就愈大。

defsEn: v. prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
v. have (one's written work) issued for publication
zh: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布
vi. 出版, 发行
examples: When will your book be published?
He had a book on physics published.
exampleZh: 你们的书什么时候会出版呢？
他有一本关于物理学的书被出版了。

defsEn: v. show a response or a reaction to something
v. act against or in opposition to
v. undergo a chemical reaction
react with another substance under certain conditions
zh: vi. 起反应, 起作用, 反攻
examples: Tom was the first to react.
Tom was too surprised to react.
exampleZh: 汤姆是最先作出反应的。
汤姆惊讶得没有反应。

defsEn: n. an official written record of names or events or transactions
n. (music) the timbre that is characteristic of a certain range and manner of production of the human voice or of different pipe organ stops or of different musical instruments
n. a book in which names and transactions are listed
n. (computer science) memory device that is the part of computer memory that has a specific address and that is used to hold information of a specific kind
zh: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册
vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号
vi. 登记, 注册, 挂号
examples: Could you please sign the register?
Should I register for that class?
exampleZh: 请您在登记册上签名好吗？
我应该登记这堂课吗？

defsEn: v have confidence or faith in
zh: vi. 信赖, 依赖, 信任
examples: You can rely upon his being punctual.
I always rely on him in times of trouble.
exampleZh: 你可以放心，他会准时的。
我在困难时总是依赖他。

defsEn: n. degree of figurative distance or separation
v. remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
v. remove from a position or an office
v. shift the position or location of, as for business, legal, educational, or military purposes
zh: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交
vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家
n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距
examples: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
Do you have anything to remove stains?
exampleZh: 请把椅子拿走，它挡着道儿了。
你有除锈的东西吗？

defsEn: n. an elaborate and systematic plan of action
v. form intrigues (for) in an underhand manner
v. devise a system or form a scheme for
zh: n. 方案, 计划, 组合, 系统, 图解, 诡计, 阴谋
v. 计划, 设计, 图谋, 策划
examples: He carried out the scheme faithfully.
Under no circumstances can the scheme be put into practice.
exampleZh: 他忠实地实行了该计划。

defsEn: n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern
n. a following of one thing after another in time
n. film consisting of a succession of related shots that develop a given subject in a movie
n. several repetitions of a melodic phrase in different keys
zh: n. 序列, 续发事件, 顺序, 连续
vt. 按顺序排好
examples: In the sequence of life, we face many challenges.
The Fibonacci sequence can be found in nature.

defsEn: n. either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided
n. all of the feelings resulting from the urge to gratify sexual impulses
n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles
v. tell the sex (of young chickens)
zh: n. 性别, 性欲
vt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲
examples: I want to have sex with him.
I want to have sex with her.
exampleZh: 我要和他发生性关系。
我要和她发生性关系。

defsEn: n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation
n. the time period during which you are at work
n. the act of moving from one place to another
n. a crew of workers who work for a specific period of time
zh: n. 变化, 移动, 轮班, 手段, 应急办法, 移位
vt. 替换, 转移, 改变, 推卸, 变速
vi. 转换, 移动, 转变, 推托, 变速
examples: Tom is working the night shift.
The car would not shift into third gear.
exampleZh: 汤姆上夜班。

defsEn: v. decide upon or fix definitely
v. determine the essential quality of
v. be specific about
zh: vt. 详列, 指定, 说明
examples: Please specify any conditions you have for the use of this information.
Tom didn't specify what he wanted.
exampleZh: 如果您有关于这份问卷信息的使用条件，请在这里指定。
汤姆没说他想要什么。

defsEn: a. of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant
zh: a. 充分的, 足够的
examples: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
exampleZh: 我们有充分的理由论证这个假设。
我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。

defsEn: v. assign a task to
zh: n. 工作, 任务, 作业, 困难的工作
vt. 派给...工作, 使辛劳
examples: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.
Since he is old, this task must be difficult for him.
exampleZh: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
他老了，所以这任务对他来说一定很难。

defsEn: n. a pickup truck with a gun mounted on it
a. of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill
a. characterizing or showing skill in or specialized knowledge of applied arts and sciences
a. of or relating to a practical subject that is organized according to scientific principles
zh: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的
examples: Do you have a technical diagram for this portion?
You should go on to a technical college.

defsEn: n. a practical method or art applied to some particular task
zh: n. 技巧, 技术, 方法
examples: Shougongsha is an old Chinese technique to test a woman's virginity.
This technique will cost you a lot less money.
exampleZh: 守宫砂是中国古代用来验证女人贞操的方法.

defsEn: n. the practical application of science to commerce or industry
zh: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语
examples: Technology will make a lot of progress in the nineties.
What is the advantage of this technology?
exampleZh: 科技在 1990 年代会有很大进步吧。
这种科技的优势是什么？

defsEn: a. well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force
s. still legally acceptable
zh: a. 有确实根据的, 有法律效力的, 正当的, 正确的
examples: The court adjudged that the will was valid.
It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.
exampleZh: 法院判决了那个遗言是有效的。
有效期到1997年3月31日为止。

defsEn: n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object
n. a publication that is one of a set of several similar publications
n. a relative amount
n. the magnitude of sound (usually in a specified direction)
zh: n. 册, 卷, 体积, 容量, 大量, 许多, 份量, 音量
vi. 成团卷起
vt. 把...收集成卷
a. 大量的
examples: Please lower the volume of the music!
Could you turn the volume down?
exampleZh: 请把音乐声调小！
你可以把音量调低一点吗？

defsEn: n. the right to obtain or make use of or take advantage of something (as services or membership)
n. a way of entering or leaving
n. a code (a series of characters or digits) that must be entered in some way (typed or dialed or spoken) to get the use of something (a telephone line or a computer or a local area network etc.)
n. (computer science) the operation of reading or writing stored information
zh: n. 通路, 入口, 接近, 进入, 使用权, 发作
vt. 访问, 存取, 接近, 使用
examples: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
The only access to the village is from the river.
exampleZh: 窃贼是从这扇门进到屋子里的。
去那个村庄的唯一途径是过河。

defsEn: a. having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
s. sufficient for the purpose
s. about average
acceptable
zh: a. 适当的, 足够的
examples: We need not only adequate water but clean water.
This meal is adequate for three.
exampleZh: 我们不仅需要充足的水，还需要干净的水。
这饭足够三个人吃。

defsEn: n. (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year
n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year
a. completing its life cycle within a year
s. occurring or payable every year
zh: n. 年刊, 年报
a. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的
examples: I don't know my father's annual income.
They have their annual conference in May.
exampleZh: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。

defsEn: s. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
s. appearing as such but not necessarily so
zh: a. 清晰可见的, 显然的, 表面上的
examples: It is apparent that he will win the election.
His apparent anger proved to be only a joke.

defsEn: v. be close or similar
s. not quite exact or correct
s. very close in resemblance
s. located close together
zh: a. 大约的, 接近的, 近似的
vt. 接近, 使接近, 粗略估计
vi. 接近于
examples: The story approximates to historical truth.
This will give you an approximate idea of the situation.
exampleZh: 故事与历史真相接近。

defsEn: n. a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
n. a theatrical pose created for effect
n. position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference (the horizon or direction of motion)
zh: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势
examples: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
He often takes a defiant attitude toward us.
exampleZh: 我希望改进自己的工作态度。
他常以反抗的态度对我们。

defsEn: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity
zh: n. 属性, 标志, 定语
vt. 把...归于, 认为...属于
examples: He attributed his success to good luck.
He attributes his success to good luck.
exampleZh: 他把他的成功归功于好运。
他将他的成功归功于好运。

defsEn: s. applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
a. not rude
marked by satisfactory (or especially minimal) adherence to social usages and sufficient but not noteworthy consideration for others
a. of or occurring within the state or between or among citizens of the state
a. of or relating to or befitting citizens as individuals
zh: a. 市民的, 公民的, 有礼貌的
examples: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
The novel is centered on the Civil War.
exampleZh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。
这篇小说的中心点是南北战争。

zh: （资料）码（在电信方面）
examples: In this secret code, each number stands for a letter of the alphabet.
With data, he's a genius. But with code -- complete numbskull.
exampleZh: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。
在处理资料上，他很有天赋。但编写代码的话，只能说一窍不通。

defsEn: v. cause to be admitted
of persons to an institution
v. engage in or perform
zh: vt. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务
examples: Have you committed this number to memory?
Bill did not commit the crime.
exampleZh: 这个号码你默记了吗？
比尔没有犯罪。

defsEn: v. transmit information
v. transmit thoughts or feelings
v. join or connect
v. be in verbal contact
interchange information or ideas
zh: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染
vi. 通讯
examples: We have to try to communicate with them.
They communicate with each other by gesture.
exampleZh: 我们要设法跟他们交流。
她们用手势沟通。

defsEn: n. a concentrated form of a foodstuff
the bulk is reduced by removing water
n. a concentrated example of something
v. make denser, stronger, or purer
v. direct one's attention on something
zh: n. 浓缩, 精选
v. 集中, 专心
examples: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
I can't concentrate. Do you mind turning off the TV?
exampleZh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
我没法集中注意力。你介意关掉电视吗?

defsEn: v. have a conference in order to talk something over
v. present
zh: vt. 授予, 带来
vi. 协商
examples: You should confer with your attorney on this matter.
I need to confer with my lawyer before I make a statement.

defsEn: n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared
n. the act of distinguishing by comparing differences
n. the perceptual effect of the juxtaposition of very different colors
n. the range of optical density and tone on a photographic negative or print (or the extent to which adjacent areas on a television screen differ in brightness)
zh: n. 差别, 对比, 对照物
vt. 使对比
vi. 成对照
examples: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
There is a stark contrast between China's order and the chaos of the West.
exampleZh: 和这幅比起上来，那幅画的色彩鲜艳多了。
中国之治与西方之乱形成了鲜明的对比。

defsEn: n. an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs
n. a series of poems or songs on the same theme
n. a periodically repeated sequence of events
n. a single complete execution of a periodically repeated phenomenon
zh: n. 周期, 循环, 自行车, 一段时间, 整套
vi. 循环, 轮转, 骑自行车
vt. 使循环, 使轮转
examples: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
Most of the pupils here cycle to school.
exampleZh: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。
这儿的学生大多骑车上学。

defsEn: n. the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote)
v. argue with one another
v. discuss the pros and cons of an issue
zh: n. 辩论, 讨论
v. 争论, 辩论
examples: I believe that the debate should be carried on.
We debated on the question of world population.
exampleZh: 我认为辩论该继续进行。
我们在世界人口问题上争辩了一番。

defsEn: n. contemptuous disregard
zh: n. 轻视, 憎恨
prep. 虽然, 尽管
examples: Despite all of the traffic we managed to make it in time.
Despite being rich, he is not happy.
exampleZh: 尽管交通很堵，我们还是设法及时赶到了。
虽然他很有钱，但他不幸福。

defsEn: n. the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)
n. one of three Cartesian coordinates that determine a position in space
v. indicate the dimensions on
v. shape or form to required dimensions
zh: n. 尺寸, 次元, 面积, 维数
vt. 标出尺寸
examples: This adds a new dimension of complexity to the problem.
That adds a new dimension to our problem.

defsEn: n. a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household
a. of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation
a. of or relating to the home
a. of or involving the home or family
zh: a. 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的
examples: This might be said to a domestic animal.
She fell victim to domestic violence.

defsEn: v. come out into view, as from concealment
v. become known or apparent
v. come up to the surface of or rise
zh: vi. 浮现, 形成, 出现, (事实)显露
examples: The secret will emerge in due course of time.
Believe it or not, a monster emerged from the bush.

defsEn: n. a misconception resulting from incorrect information
n. (baseball) a failure of a defensive player to make an out when normal play would have sufficed
n. departure from what is ethically acceptable
n. (computer science) the occurrence of an incorrect result produced by a computer
zh: n. 错误, 过失, 失误, 误差
examples: There is an error in this sentence.
At last, he realized his error.
exampleZh: 这句话有个错。
他终于醒觉到自己做错了。

defsEn: n. a person who is a member of an ethnic group
zh: a. 人种的, 种族的
examples: Do you know an ethnic dance?
If you are an ethnic writer, you have a burden of representation.

defsEn: n. the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it
n. game equipment consisting of the place toward which players of a game try to advance a ball or puck in order to score points
n. a successful attempt at scoring
zh: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员
vi. 攻门, 射门得分
examples: Her life goal is to marry a rich man.
Her goal is to become a teacher.
exampleZh: 她的人生目标就是找个有钱的老公。
她的目的是成为教师。

defsEn: n. any monetary aid
n. the act of providing a subsidy
n. (law) a transfer of property by deed of conveyance
n. Scottish painter
cousin of Lytton Strachey and member of the Bloomsbury Group (1885-1978)
zh: n. 授予, 授予物, 允许
vt. 允许, 承认, 授与
examples: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
He received a grant to study in Germany.
exampleZh: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。
他获得了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

defsEn: r. from this place
r. from this time
zh: adv. 因此, 从此
examples: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
Hence, they compete in the same market.
exampleZh: 因此，我们必须自己照顾自己。

defsEn: n. a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations
n. a tentative insight into the natural world
a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
zh: n. 假设
examples: I think it's a reasonable hypothesis.
So far, it's just a hypothesis.

defsEn: n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end
v. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
zh: n. 工具, 器具, 手段
vt. 实现, 使生效, 执行
examples: They implemented a communication policy so as to promote their new concept.
Our company will implement new price standards regarding this product.
exampleZh: 他们到位了实行新概念的广告策略。
关于这个产品，我公司将执行新的价格标准。

defsEn: v. bring into intimate and incriminating connection
zh: vt. 涉及, 含意, 暗示, 牵连
n. 包含的东西
examples: If you implicate me, I'm warning you, I won't go down alone.
Yanni never implicated himself in the murder of his wife and child.

defsEn: v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect
zh: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗
vi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响
examples: He always imposes his opinion on me.
Why do you want to impose your religion on me?
exampleZh: 他总是把他的看法强加给我。

defsEn: v. make into a whole or make part of a whole
v. become one
become integrated
v. calculate the integral of
calculate by integration
zh: vt. 综合, 使完整, 使成整体
vi. 成一体
a. 完整的, 完全的
examples: They have to integrate into society.
They refuse to integrate into society.

defsEn: a. happening or arising or located within some limits or especially surface
s. occurring within an institution or community
zh: a. 内在的, 国内的
examples: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.
They should not intervene in the internal affairs of another country.
exampleZh: 电脑内部计时器内的纽扣电池没电了。

defsEn: v. investigate scientifically
v. conduct an inquiry or investigation of
zh: v. 调查, 审查
examples: We have to thoroughly investigate it.
We have investigated his criminal record.
exampleZh: 我们必须把它彻底检查一下。
我们调查了他的犯规记录。

defsEn: n. a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
n. a workplace
as in the expression "on the job"
n. an object worked on
a result produced by working
n. the responsibility to do something
zh: n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
vt. 代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
examples: Do you want this job or not?
I start a new job tomorrow.
exampleZh: 你想不想要这工作？
明天我要去做一份新工作。

defsEn: n. a brief description given for purposes of identification
n. trade name of a company that produces musical recordings
n. a radioactive isotope that is used in a compound in order to trace the mechanism of a chemical reaction
n. an identifying or descriptive marker that is attached to an object
zh: n. 标签, 称号, 商标, 标志
vt. 贴标签于, 标注
examples: He's always putting labels on people.
He's always slapping labels on others.
exampleZh: 他老是给别人扣帽子。
他老是给别人扣帽子。

defsEn: n. the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction
n. the technical aspects of doing something
n. a natural object resembling a machine in structure or function
n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that all phenomena can be explained in terms of physical or biological causes
zh: n. 机械, 机构, 结构, 机理, 技巧
examples: It can be a defense mechanism.
Its mechanism will cease to work.

defsEn: a. easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
zh: a. 明显的, 明白的, 显然的, 平淡无奇的
examples: It was obvious that they had told a lie.
It's obvious why his stomach hurts.
exampleZh: 他们分明说了谎。
他为什么会胃痛的原因很明显。

defsEn: v. live (in a certain place)
v. occupy the whole of

examples: Books occupy most of his room.
The meeting room is occupied at the moment.
exampleZh: 书堆满了他的房间。
会议室正在使用中。

defsEn: n. the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price
the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited
n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
zh: n. 选择权, 挑选, 选项
examples: I don't have a lot of options.
Veggie burgers are a plant-based option.
exampleZh: 我没有太多选择。
素食汉堡是一种蔬食选择。

defsEn: n. production of a certain amount
n. the quantity of something (as a commodity) that is created (usually within a given period of time)
n. what is produced in a given time period
v. to create or manufacture a specific amount

Last year's output of coal fell short of the standard.

defsEn: n. (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps)
n. a loose protective coverall or smock worn over ordinary clothing for dirty work
s. involving only main features
s. including everything

adv. 从头到尾, 总的说来
n. 罩衫, 工作服
examples: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
Without electricity, the overall health and well-being of the population deteriorates.
exampleZh: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。

defsEn: n. (mathematics) one of a set of parallel geometric figures (parallel lines or planes)
v. be parallel to
v. make or place parallel to something
a. being everywhere equidistant and not intersecting
zh: n. 平行, 对比, 相匹敌之物
a. 平行的, 相似的
vt. 与...平行, 与...相似, 相比, 使平行
examples: The two streets run parallel to one another.
The road runs parallel to the river.
exampleZh: 两条街道互相平行。
这条路与河流平行。

defsEn: n. a constant in the equation of a curve that can be varied to yield a family of similar curves
n. any factor that defines a system and determines (or limits) its performance

The system parameters comply with the standard.

defsEn: n. any distinct time period in a sequence of events

matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary
n. a particular point in the time of a cycle
measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle
n. (astronomy) the particular appearance of a body's state of illumination (especially one of the recurring shapes of the part of Earth's moon that is illuminated by the sun)
zh: n. 时期, 局面, 方面, 位相, 相, 阶段
vt. 使调整相位, 使定相, 使一致, 逐步执行, 实行
examples: The first phase of construction has been completed.
The decision-making phase can take a while.
exampleZh: 工程的第一阶段已经完成了。

defsEn: v. make a prediction about
tell in advance
zh: v. 预知, 预言, 预报
examples: No one can predict the future.
It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
exampleZh: 没人能预测未来。
很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

defsEn: n. the original amount of a debt on which interest is calculated

n. capital as contrasted with the income derived from it

zh: n. 校长, 首长, 本金, 主犯, 资本, 委托人
a. 主要的, 最重要的, 首要的
examples: The principal wants to talk to you.
I have lost both principal and interest.
exampleZh: 校长想跟你谈话。
我本金和利息都没了。

defsEn: n. the head of a religious order
in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot

n. 小隐修院院长, 大隐修院副院长
examples: I have no prior knowledge of him.
I'm afraid that I have a prior engagement.

defsEn: n. a person engaged in one of the learned professions
n. an athlete who plays for pay
a. engaged in a profession or engaging in as a profession or means of livelihood
a. of or relating to or suitable as a profession
zh: n. 专业人才
a. 专业的, 职业的
examples: Professional writers do not have a regular income.
Her acting is on the level of a professional.
exampleZh: 专职作家没有固定的收入。
她的演技堪比专业人士。

defsEn: n. a planned undertaking
v. communicate vividly
v. transfer (ideas or principles) from one domain into another
v. project on a screen
zh: n. 计划, 设计, 事业
vt. 计划, 设计, 投掷, 发射, 使凸出, 放映
vi. 凸出
examples: I know about this project for the most part.
I intend to see the project through.
exampleZh: 这个项目我大致了解。
我打算完成这个项目。

defsEn: v. contribute to the progress or growth of
v. give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v. be changed for a superior chess or checker piece
v. change a pawn for a better piece by advancing it to the eighth row, or change a checker piece for a more valuable piece by moving it to the row closest to your opponent
zh: vt. 促进, 晋升, 创办, 推销
examples: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
Exercise can promote a better sex life.
exampleZh: 爸爸说他明年就要被升为部门主管了。

defsEn: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
n (medicine) a systematic plan for therapy (often including diet)
zh: n. 政权, 当权期间, 政体, 社会制度, 体制, 情态
examples: His regime is bound to collapse.
In a democratic regime, power must emanate from the people.
exampleZh: 他的政权必定会崩溃。

defsEn: v. make clearly visible
v. find the solution
zh: vi. 决定, 分解, 决心
vt. 使分解, 解析, 解决, 消除, 决心
n. 决定之事, 决心, 坚决
examples: I resolved to keep a diary this year.
I hope they can resolve it amicably.
exampleZh: 这一年我下了决心写日记。
我希望他们能和平地解决。

defsEn: v. hold back within
v. allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature
v. secure and keep for possible future use or application
v. keep in one's mind
zh: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 记得, 付定金聘请
examples: Retain this manual for future reference.
Anyone who retains the ability to recognize beauty will never grow old.

defsEn: n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another
n. a periodical that appears at scheduled times
n. (sports) several contests played successively by the same teams
n. (electronics) connection of components in such a manner that current flows first through one and then through the other
zh: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组
examples: Why are series about time travel so popular at the moment?
They watched a TV series tonight.
exampleZh: 现在穿越剧为什么这么火？
他们今晚看了电视连续剧。

defsEn: n. a datum that can be represented numerically
zh: n. 统计量
a. 统计的, 统计学的
examples: I took these statistics from a government white paper on education.
Statistics show that very few people live to be a hundred.

defsEn: n. the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society
zh: n. 状态, 情形, 地位, 要人身份
examples: Citizens of higher social status were permitted to live closer to the center.
I want to check the status of my order.
exampleZh: 社会地位较高的公民被允许住在较靠近市中心的地方。

defsEn: n. the relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)
n. special emphasis attached to something
n. difficulty that causes worry or emotional tension
n. (physics) force that produces strain on a physical body
zh: n. 压力, 紧迫, 强调, 重音, 重点, 应力
vt. 加压力于, 着重, 重读
examples: Where do you place the stress in the word "Australia"?
They say stress causes high blood pressure.
exampleZh: “Australia”这个词的重音要放在哪？
他们说压力导致高血压。

defsEn: a. following in time or order
zh: a. 后来的, 接下去的
examples: The subsequent effects of the attack decimated the tourism industry there.
I can't remember the subsequent events.

defsEn: n. a quantity of money
n. a quantity obtained by the addition of a group of numbers
n. the final aggregate
n. the whole amount
zh: n. 总数, 总和, 金额, 概要, 顶点
vt. 总计, 概括
vi. 合计
examples: She had only a small sum of money.
Dictatorship can be summed up by "shut up!", democracy by "keep talking".
exampleZh: 她当时只有一丁点儿钱。
就算独裁国家是“闭上你的嘴”，民主国家才是“当你放屁”。

defsEn: n. a brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
zh: n. 摘要, 概要
a. 摘要的, 简略的
examples: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
Give me a summary of the book.
exampleZh: 下面是总统讲话的概要。

defsEn: v. enter upon an activity or enterprise
v. accept as a challenge
v. promise to do or accomplish
v. accept as a charge
zh: vt. 试图, 从事, 保证, 承担, 同意, 接受
examples: He is too young to undertake this work.
I have a mind to undertake the work.
exampleZh: 他太年轻，无法胜任这项工作。

defsEn: n. a secondary school (usually private)
n. an institution for the advancement of art or science or literature
n. a school for special training
n. a learned establishment for the advancement of knowledge
zh: n. 学院, 院校, 学会
examples: The results of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' survey are like this.
Do you go to an academy?
exampleZh: 中国科学院的调查结果是这样的。

defsEn: v. alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
v. make correspondent or conformable
v. decide how much is to be paid on an insurance claim
zh: vt. 调整, 使适应于, 校准
vi. 适应于, 被调节, 相互熟悉而适应
examples: I need a week to adjust to the time difference.
I can't adjust myself to the climate here.
exampleZh: 我需要一个星期来倒时差。
我不能适应这里的气候。

defsEn: v. make an alteration to
v. remove the ovaries of
zh: v. 改变
examples: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
She altered her old clothes to make them look more fashionable.
exampleZh: 他提出改革研究方法的意见。

defsEn: v. make amendments to
zh: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改过自新
examples: I want to make amends for my behavior.
He will make amends for the damage.

defsEn: a. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
zh: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的
examples: He doesn't seem to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
He was not aware of the danger.
exampleZh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
他没有意识到自己有危险。

defsEn: n. capability to perform or produce
n. the amount that can be contained
n. the maximum production possible
n. a specified function
zh: n. 容量, 能力, 才能, 资格
examples: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
exampleZh: 细胞具有将食物转化为能量的能力。
人类适应环境变化的能力很强。

defsEn: n. a demanding or stimulating situation
n. a call to engage in a contest or fight
n. questioning a statement and demanding an explanation
n. a formal objection to the selection of a particular person as a juror
zh: n. 挑战, 盘问
vt. 向...挑战, 要求, 怀疑
vi. 挑战, 对(证据等)表示异议
examples: She said she enjoyed the challenge.
I don't get enough challenge in this job.
exampleZh: 她说她喜欢那个挑战。
这份工作没什么挑战性。

defsEn: n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
zh: n. 子句, 条款

Is there a clause in the lease regarding that?
exampleZh: 条件状语从句包含四种主要类型。

defsEn: n. a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts

n. an enclosure of residences and other building (especially in the Orient)
v. put or add together
zh: n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子
a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协
vt. 使复合, 使化合
examples: Do you know what compound words are?
Compound interest is the most powerful force in the universe.
exampleZh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

defsEn: n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
n. opposition between two simultaneous but incompatible feelings
n. a state of opposition between persons or ideas or interests
n. an incompatibility of dates or events
zh: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执
vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
examples: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
exampleZh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

defsEn: v. get or ask advice from
v. seek information from
v. advise professionally
zh: vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊
vt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑
examples: You should consult with a pharmacist before buying that medicine.
I don't know who to consult with.
exampleZh: 你在买这药之前应该问一下药剂师的建议。
我不知道该和谁商量好。

defsEn: n. close interaction
n. the act of touching physically
n. the state or condition of touching or of being in immediate proximity
n. the physical coming together of two or more things

vi. 接触, 联系
vt. 使接触
examples: You can contact me in case of emergency.
They will contact us before noon today.
exampleZh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
他们会在今天中午之前联系我们。

defsEn: n. change toward something smaller or lower
n. a condition inferior to an earlier condition
a gradual falling off from a better state

v. go down

vt. 使降低, 婉谢
vi. 下降, 衰落, 偏斜

It is very impolite of her to decline our invitation.

defsEn: s. constituting a separate entity or part

drawn by one person or bank on another

n. a serving of drink (usually alcoholic) drawn from a keg
zh: n. 气流, 草稿, 汇票, 草案
vt. 起草, 征兵

Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.

生啤酒在大热天时特别好喝。

zh: vt. 使能够

exampleZh: 咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。

defsEn: n. (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work
the units of energy are joules or ergs

n. an imaginative lively style (especially style of writing)
zh: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量

It still costs energy to chop it off.
exampleZh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
还要花能量砍掉。

defsEn: v. ensure observance of laws and rules
v. compel to behave in a certain way

zh: n. 实体, 实存物, 存在

the standard is 8 for oxygen
s. being essentially equal to something
zh: n. 同等物, 等价物, 相等物
a. 相等的, 相当的, 同意义的
examples: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
That Japanese word has no equivalent in English.
exampleZh: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。
那个日文词汇没有对应的英文。

defsEn: v. work out
v. undergo development or evolution
zh: vi. 进展, 进化, 展开

defsEn: v. extend in one or more directions
v. become larger in size or volume or quantity
v. make bigger or wider in size, volume, or quantity

vi. 张开, 发展

That market has been rapidly expanding.
exampleZh: 他真的很需要扩大自己的柏柏语词汇量。
那个市场一直在急速扩展。

defsEn: n. the exposure of an impostor or a fraud

s. from or between other countries
zh: n. 外部, 外面
a. 外部的, 客观的, 表面的

External air conditioners are quite cheap.
exampleZh: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。
室外的空调很便宜。

defsEn: v. make easier
v. increase the likelihood of (a response)

物理是基础自然科学。

defsEn: v. bring into existence
v. produce (energy)

The machine generated large amounts of electricity.
exampleZh: 那台机器可以发很多电。
机器发了很多电。

n. the production of heat or electricity
zh: n. 一代, 一世, 产生

lack of due restraint

v authorize officially

a. 医学的, 内科的, 药的

公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。

defsEn: a. involving the mind or an intellectual process
a. of or relating to the mind

我当时在国外。

n. the generally accepted perspective of a particular discipline at a given time
zh: n. 范例, 式样, 词形变化表, 纵聚合关系语言项
examples: A paradigm is something you think about before you think about it.

defsEn: n. any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
n. a remarkable development
zh: n. 现象, 迹象, 表现, 奇迹, 奇才
examples: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
It's a phenomenon I've never seen before.
exampleZh: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
这是我以前从未见过的现象。

defsEn: n. preceding in time
zh: n. 优先权, 优先
examples: You have the priority to get on this elevator over me.
Could we make this a priority?

defsEn: v command against
zh: vt. 禁止, 阻止
examples: Who would prohibit such a thing?
Poor health prohibited him from traveling.
exampleZh: 谁会禁止这样的事情呢？
因为健康状况不佳，他没去成旅行。

defsEn: n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution
n. the communication of something to the public
making information generally known
n. the business of issuing printed matter for sale or distribution
zh: n. 出版物, 出版, 公布
examples: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
Take my favorite publication in the gift shop.
exampleZh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

defsEn: v. repeat a passage from
v. name the price of
v. refer to for illustration or proof
v. put quote marks around
zh: n. 引用
vt. 引述, 举证, 报(价)
vi. 引用
examples: Where does this quote come from?
Tatoeba: Where quotes go to die.
exampleZh: 这个引用出自哪里？
Tatoeba:是一个引述都去死的地方。

defsEn: n. merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)
n. a process that liberates or discharges something
n. a device that when pressed will release part of a mechanism
n. activity that frees or expresses creative energy or emotion
zh: n. 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书
vt. 释放, 解除, 放松, 豁免, 免除, 发布, 放弃, 让与
n. 发布
examples: An octopus can release ink when it gets into danger.
The girl released the birds from the cage.
exampleZh: 章鱼遇到危险时会喷出墨汁。
女孩把鸟儿从笼中放了出来。

defsEn: n. a relation of direct opposition
n. the gears by which the motion of a machine can be reversed
n. an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes
something that is thwarting or frustrating
n. the side of a coin or medal that does not bear the principal design
zh: n. 相反, 背面, 倒退, 挫折, 失败
a. 反面的, 相反的, 反向的, 颠倒的
vt. 使颠倒, 使逆转, 使倒退, 使反向
vi. 倒退, 反向, 倒转, 反转
examples: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
He did the reverse of what I asked.
exampleZh: 背心反了， 要翻一个面。
他做的和我要求的相反。

defsEn: v. make a pretence of
zh: vt. 模拟, 假装, 模仿
examples: Why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
Chess is a game that simulates the conflict between two armies.

defsEn: n. the underside of footwear or a golf club
n. lean flesh of any of several flatfish
n. the underside of the foot
n. right-eyed flatfish
many are valued as food
most common in warm seas especially European
zh: n. 脚掌, 鞋底, 底部
a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 单独的, 独身的
vt. 上鞋底, 触底
examples: My sole idea was to get there as fast as possible.
I have a callus on the sole of my foot.

defsEn: r to a small degree or extent
r to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
zh: n. 某物, 几分
adv. 多少, 几分
examples: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.
That is somewhat explained at the end.
exampleZh: 租的房屋要离我工作地方近一点。
这在最后得到了莫名的解释。

defsEn: v. refer for judgment or consideration
v. put before
v. yield to the control of another
v. yield to another's wish or opinion
zh: vt. 使服从, 使受到, 委托, 提交, 认为
vi. 屈服, 服从
examples: In Islam, you submit your will to God.
Tell him he should submit his immediate resignation.

defsEn: n. a person who follows next in order
n. a thing or person that immediately replaces something or someone
n. a person who inherits some title or office
zh: n. 继承者, 接任者
examples: The matter of his successor is still under debate.
He passed on the torch to his successor.

defsEn: v. continue to live through hardship or adversity
v. continue in existence after (an adversity, etc.)
zh: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于
vi. 活下来, 幸存
examples: I had to do that to survive.
I once hoped that my mother would survive until I got married.
exampleZh: 我不得不这么做以维生。
我曾经希望我妈妈能活到我结婚的时候。

defsEn: n. an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
zh: n. 论题, 论文
examples: Are you preparing for your thesis defense?
A university thesis describes the "Orientalism" that imbues sci-fi in the West.
exampleZh: 你在准备论文答辩吗？
一篇大学论文描述了充斥在西方科幻作品中的「东方主义」。

defsEn: n. some situation or event that is thought about
zh: n. 主题, 论题, 话题
examples: It's not a suitable topic for discussion.
He changed the topic of conversation.
exampleZh: 它不是一个适合讨论的主题。
他转变了话题。

defsEn: v. send from one person or place to another
zh: vt. 传输, 传染, 传达, 遗传, 发射, 传播
vi. 发射信号, 留传下来
examples: Life is a fatal sexually transmitted disease.
We have to transmit our culture to the next generation.
exampleZh: 生命是一种致命的性传染病。

defsEn: n. the finest or most superior quality of its kind
a. furthest or highest in degree or order
utmost or extreme
s. being the last or concluding element of a series
zh: n. 终极, 根本, 顶点, 基本原则
a. 终极的, 根本的, 极限的, 最远的, 最后的, 最大的
examples: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
What is the ultimate purpose of education?
exampleZh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
教育的最终目的是什么？

defsEn: s. (followed by `to') applying exclusively to a given category or condition or locality
s. highly unusual or rare but not the single instance
zh: a. 独一无二的, 独特的, 稀罕的
examples: You have a unique sense of humor.
Your unique perspective and kindness could truly make a positive impact on my world.

defsEn: a. capable of being seen
or open to easy view
s. obvious to the eye
s. present and easily available
zh: a. 看得见的, 明显的, 显然的
n. 可见物
examples: That star is visible to the naked eye.
It is visible to the naked eye.
exampleZh: 那颗星星可以用裸眼看到。
肉眼可见。

defsEn: n. composition (often improvised) for a solo instrument (especially solo organ) and not a regular part of a religious service or musical performance
a. of your own free will or design
done by choice
not forced or compelled
a. controlled by individual volition
zh: a. 自动的, 自愿的, 故意的, 志愿的, 自发的
n. 自愿行动, 志愿者, 自由调
examples: She did a lot of voluntary work for the Red Cross.
He made a voluntary contribution to the school.

defsEn: n. the trait of lacking restraint or control
reckless freedom from inhibition or worry
v. forsake, leave behind
v. give up with the intent of never claiming again
v. stop maintaining or insisting on
of ideas or claims
zh: vt. 放弃, 抛弃, 遗弃, 使屈从, 沉溺, 放纵
n. 放任, 无拘束, 狂热
examples: We have to abandon the plan.
He abandoned his hope of becoming a doctor.
exampleZh: 我们必须放弃这个计划。
他放弃了成为医生的希望。

defsEn: v. go or travel along with
zh: vt. 陪伴, 伴随, 补充, 为...伴奏
vi. 伴奏, 伴唱
examples: She will accompany me on the piano.
I'll accompany you to the airport.
exampleZh: 她会弹钢琴为我伴奏。
我陪你去机场吧。

defsEn: v. collect or gather
zh: v. 积聚, 堆积
examples: Dust had accumulated in the attic.
He accumulated a tremendous fortune during the post war.
exampleZh: 阁楼上积了灰。

defsEn: a. having more than one possible meaning
s. having no intrinsic or objective meaning
not organized in conventional patterns
zh: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的
examples: An ambiguous sentence is very difficult to translate.
I admit this is an ambiguous answer.

defsEn: v. add to the very end
v. fix to
attach
zh: vt. 附加, 增补, 盖章
当程序执行时, DOS将在所设定的磁盘路径中查找不在当前路径下的文件
examples: You can append new data to the existing file.
The editor asked me to append a glossary to the manuscript.

defsEn: v. recognize with gratitude
be grateful for
v. be fully aware of
realize fully
v. gain in value
v. increase the value of
zh: vt. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏
vi. 增值, 涨价
examples: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.
I really appreciate what you've done.
exampleZh: 我深深地感激你的建议和好心。
我真的很感激你所做的一切。

defsEn: a. based on or subject to individual discretion or preference or sometimes impulse or caprice
zh: a. 任意的, 武断的, 专治的, 霸道的
examples: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
Happiness and success are not arbitrary, but depend on your attitude concerning life.
exampleZh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

defsEn: v make automatic or control or operate automatically
zh: vt.vi. (使)自动化
examples: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
They think that your work could be automated in the future.
exampleZh: 这是自动投币电话，用一元硬币来打的。

defsEn: n. a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
v. influence in an unfair way
v. cause to be biased
s. slanting diagonally across the grain of a fabric
zh: n. 偏见, 斜纹
a. 偏斜的
adv. 偏斜
vt. 使有偏见
examples: I know I have a biased opinion.
I know that I may be biased.

defsEn: n. a visual display of information
n. a map designed to assist navigation by air or sea
v. make a chart of
v. plan in detail
zh: n. 图表, 海图
vt. 制成图表
examples: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
Would you explain that chart to me?
exampleZh: 下面的图标显示了这个流程图

defsEn: v. make clear and (more) comprehensible
v. make clear by removing impurities or solids, as by heating
zh: vi. 澄清, 阐明
vt. 使明晰
examples: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
Could you clarify your last point?
exampleZh: 感谢你帮我解释明白。

defsEn: n. articles of commerce
zh: n. 农产品, 商品, 有用的物品
examples: Sales of this commodity are off to a good start.
Commodity tax is not included in the price.

defsEn: n. a word or phrase used to complete a grammatical construction
n. a complete number or quantity
n. number needed to make up a whole force
n. something added to complete or embellish or make perfect
zh: n. 补足物, 补语, 补数
vt. 补充, 补足
examples: Replace the complement with the appropriate pronoun.
I think that we complement each other.

defsEn: v. be similar, be in line with
zh: vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合
vi. 一致, 符合, 适应
examples: We must conform to the rules.
We should conform to the customs of society.
exampleZh: 我们必须遵守规则。

defsEn: n. a person of nearly the same age as another
s. characteristic of the present
s. belonging to the present time
zh: n. 同时代的人
a. 同时代的, 属于同一时期的
examples: Contemporary Chinese youth culture is very shallow.
What do you think of contemporary art?
exampleZh: 中国的当代青年文化很空洞。

defsEn: v. be in contradiction with
v. deny the truth of
zh: vt. 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾
vi. 反驳
examples: Why do you always contradict me?
Do you dare to contradict me?

defsEn: a. of extreme importance
vital to the resolution of a crisis
s. having crucial relevance
zh: a. 决定性的, 重要的, 严厉的
examples: The next four to six weeks are crucial in controlling the massive Ebola outbreak.
The telephone rang at the most crucial point in the conversation.
exampleZh: 接下来的四到六周将对于控制伊波拉病毒的大爆发至关重要。

defsEn: n. the metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used
n. general acceptance or use
zh: n. 货币, 通货, 流通, 通用
examples: What currency do you use in England?
What is the currency of Taiwan?
exampleZh: 你在英国用什么钱买东西？
台湾的货币是什么 ?

defsEn: v. be a sign or indication of
v. have as a meaning
zh: vt. 指示, 表示
examples: The prison perimeter is denoted by a large fence.
Californium is a chemical element denoted by the symbol Cf.

defsEn: v. discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
zh: vt. 发现, 察觉, 探测
examples: He was detected in the very act of stealing.
Do I detect a hint of sarcasm in your reply?
exampleZh: 他在行窃的时后被发现。

defsEn: v. turn aside
turn away from
v. be at variance with
be out of line with
v. cause to turn away from a previous or expected course
zh: vi. 脱离, 偏离
vt. 使偏离
a. 脱离常规的
n. 脱离常规的人
examples: I will never deviate from my path.
Do not deviate from the standard operating procedure.

defsEn: v. cause to move, usually with force or pressure
v. terminate the employment of
discharge from an office or position
zh: vt. 移置, 替换, 转移
examples: The villagers were displaced by the construction of a dam.
Drought could displace millions of Algerians.

defsEn: n. an episode that is turbulent or highly emotional
n. the literary genre of works intended for the theater
n. the quality of being arresting or highly emotional
zh: n. 戏剧, 戏剧艺术
examples: Which drama series do you like best?
They made the novel into a drama.
exampleZh: 你最喜欢什么电视剧？
他们把这本小说变成戏剧。

defsEn: s. expected to follow in the indefinite future from causes already operating
zh: a. 最后的, 终于的
examples: His mistakes led to his eventual dismissal.

defsEn: n. an object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence
v. show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
zh: n. 显示, 显现, 展览品, 陈列品, 展览
vt. 展现, 陈列, 展览
vi. 开展览会
examples: I'm going to exhibit my roses at the flower show.
By putting the work on exhibit, more people will be able to contemplate it.
exampleZh: 我要把我的玫瑰拿到花展上展示。

defsEn: v. use or manipulate to one's advantage
v. draw from
make good use of
zh: n. 功绩, 勋绩
vt. 开发, 利用, 开拓, 剥削
examples: The capitalists tend to exploit the working people.
He exploited his position to build up his fortune.
exampleZh: 资本家倾向于压榨工人。

defsEn: v. cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern
v. move or sway in a rising and falling or wavelike pattern
v. be unstable
zh: vi. 变动, 起伏, 动摇
vt. 使波动, 使动摇
examples: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
exampleZh: 黄金的价格每天波动。
该政策在两种意见之间摇摆。

defsEn: n. a light line that is used in lettering to help align the letters
zh: n. 指导路线, 方针, 指标
examples: Actually, it's really more of a guideline than a rule.
These are just guidelines, not hard and fast rules.

defsEn: n. the most interesting or memorable part
n. an area of lightness in a picture
v. apply a highlighter to one's cheeks or eyebrows in order to make them more prominent
zh: n. 加亮区, 精彩场面
vt. 加亮, 使显著, 以强光照射, 突出
examples: Highlight the sentence you want to copy.
You should highlight this sentence here.

defsEn: a. implied though not directly expressed
inherent in the nature of something
s. being without doubt or reserve
zh: a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 绝对的
examples: We had an implicit agreement that we would support each other.
Some implicit elements can be made explicit.

defsEn: v. cause to arise
v. cause to do
cause to act in a specified manner
v. cause to occur rapidly
v. reason or establish by induction
zh: vt. 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应
examples: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
What can have induced him to behave so cruelly?

defsEn: n. an unavoidable event
a. incapable of being avoided or prevented
s. invariably occurring or appearing
zh: a. 不可避免的, 必然的
examples: It is inevitable that I go to France someday, I just don't know when.
The troubles of life are inevitable.
exampleZh: 我总有一天是必须去法国的，但不知道是何时。
生活中的烦恼在所难免。

defsEn: n. the basic structure or features of a system or organization
n. the stock of basic facilities and capital equipment needed for the functioning of a country or area
zh: n. 基础结构, 基础设施
examples: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
How will Algeria fund its infrastructure in the future?
exampleZh: 一个应用的架构直接关系到它的整体性能。

defsEn: v. look over carefully
zh: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验
vi. 检查
examples: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.
exampleZh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？
所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。

defsEn: a. possessing or displaying a distinctive feature to a heightened degree
s. (of color) having the highest saturation
zh: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的
examples: How are you keeping off this intense heat?
I struggle to contain the intense anger within me.
exampleZh: 你是怎么避开这酷暑的？

defsEn: v. influence or control shrewdly or deviously
v. hold something in one's hands and move it
v. control (others or oneself) or influence skillfully, usually to one's advantage
v. treat manually, as with massage, for therapeutic purposed
zh: vt. 操纵, 利用, 操作, 巧妙地处理, 假造
examples: You know how to manipulate me.
They think they can manipulate us.

defsEn: v represent as less significant or important
v make small or insignificant
zh: vt. 使减到最少/最小, 使降到最低限度, 使缩到最小, 极度轻视
examples: Is there some way we can minimise the risk?

defsEn: a. (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy
a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of an atom
a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of a cell
s. constituting or like a nucleus
zh: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的
examples: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
This time, the nuclear test was a success.
exampleZh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。
这次核试验成功了。

defsEn: n. a plate makes an inked impression on a rubber-blanketed cylinder, which in turn transfers it to the paper
v. compensate for or counterbalance
v. cause (printed matter) to transfer or smear onto another surface
v. create an offset in
zh: n. 抵消, 把...并列, 旁系, 支管, 用胶印法印
vt. 弥补, 抵消, 胶印
vi. 装支管
n. 偏移量
examples: If not for carbon offsetting, we'd be in danger of runaway emissions.
Is there any way to offset those costs?

defsEn: n. one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas
the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line
v. divide into paragraphs, as of text
v. write about in a paragraph
v. write paragraphs
work as a paragrapher
zh: n. 段落, 短评
vt. 将...分段, 分段落
vi. 写短讯
examples: Read the first paragraph of the text for me.
Could you tell me what this paragraph means?

defsEn: a. on the positive side or higher end of a scale
s. involving advantage or good
zh: prep. 加上, 加, 外加
a. 正的, 附加的
n. 正号, 加号, 附加额, 正数, 增益
examples: One plus two is equal to three.
The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.
exampleZh: 一加二等于三。
二加三加四的和是九。

defsEn: n. someone who practices a learned profession
zh: n. 从业者, 开业者
examples: The medical practitioner I had previously prescribed a different dose.
Tom is a practitioner in the black arts.

defsEn: s most frequent or common
s having superior power and influence
zh: a. 占主导地位的, 卓越的
examples: You could say that France is the predominant cultural power in Europe.

defsEn: n. the possibility of future success
v. search for something desirable
v. explore for useful or valuable things or substances, such as minerals
zh: n. 景色, 展望
vt. 勘探, 勘察
vi. 勘探, 有前途
examples: The prospect of spending a whole day with him excited me.
Unfortunately, there's no prospect of recovery.

defsEn: n. a person who has radical ideas or opinions
n. (mathematics) a quantity expressed as the root of another quantity
n. a character conveying the lexical meaning of a logogram
s. arising from or going to the root or source
zh: n. 激进分子, 词根, 基础, 根式, 根
a. 激进的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的
examples: The radical in the Chinese character for "good" is the character for "woman".
She has a very radical opinion about the problem.
exampleZh: “好”的部首是女。
她对于这个问题有很激进的意见。

defsEn: a. lacking any definite plan or order or purpose
governed by or depending on chance
zh: n. 随意, 随机
a. 任意的, 随便的, 胡乱的, 随机的
adv. 胡乱地
examples: Your random firing will scare away the prey.
He fired a shot at random.
exampleZh: 你胡乱打枪，会吓跑猎物的。
他随便开了一枪。

defsEn: v. make stronger
v. strengthen and support with rewards
zh: vt. 加强, 增援, 补充
vi. 求援, 得到增援
n. 加固材料
examples: We need to reinforce the roof.
If the concrete is not reinforced with high-quality steel, it will be worthless.

defsEn: v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition
v. give or bring back
v. bring back into original existence, use, function, or position
zh: vt. 回复, 恢复, 归还, 修补, 修复
vt. 还原
vi. 还原
examples: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
How on earth can we restore our youth?
exampleZh: 一座历史地标已经修复并将重新开放。

defsEn: v. make revisions in
zh: n. 校订, 修正, 改样
vt. 校订, 修正, 校正
examples: I have to revise for a biology test.
I need to review and revise my approach.

有个穿白色制服的女孩帮我量了体温。

Edmundo threw Rima off the vehicle.

埃德蒙多把里玛从车上推下去了。

London.

他终于达到目标了。

defsEn: n. a contentious speech act
a dispute where there is strong disagreement

examples: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.
You should have shown him the device.
exampleZh: 有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
你应该给他看看这装置。

defsEn: v. set aside or apart for a specific purpose or use

他的内疚感减少了。

examples: They said the situation was only temporary.
Form is temporary, class is permanent.
exampleZh: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。

defsEn: n. a device that activates or releases or causes something to happen
n. an act that sets in motion some course of events
v. release or pull the trigger on
zh: n. 触发器, 扳机
vt. 触发, 发射, 引起
vi. 松开扳柄
examples: Their small protest triggered a mass demonstration.
We will trigger a revolution in the IT industry.
exampleZh: 他们小型的示威引发了一场大规模的游行。

defsEn: v. become one
zh: v. 统一, 使成一体
examples: He tried to unify the various groups.
He will be fighting to unify the titles.
exampleZh: 他试着统一不同的团体。

defsEn: v. fail to agree with
be in violation of
as of rules or patterns
v. destroy
zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍
examples: I will never violate a law again.
I'll never violate a law again.
exampleZh: 我不会再违法了。
我不会再违法了。

defsEn: n. a vivid mental image
n. the perceptual experience of seeing
n. a religious or mystical experience of a supernatural appearance
zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想
vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
examples: My vision is getting worse these days.
Can you share your vision of a perfect date?
exampleZh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
